Maryville College’s Business Office is located on the first floor of Fayerweather Hall, right in the middle of campus. Open from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday, the Business Office is responsible for handling monetary transactions and related record keeping for the College. This includes payroll distribution for all Maryville College employees and college work-study students, disbursement of payments for goods and services purchased by the College, billing and collection of student tuition accounts, and complete record keeping for all ledger accounts and budget.
